confidence_note: ECE and reliability use the top-1 probability; coverage uses the response confidence field (1 - H/ln K for choice and score, max(p, 1 - p) for noul).

calibration.fit_on: the first 1800 interactions of runs/v3_log_emotion_s0/log.jsonl (N 2000), Bernoulli log-likelihood of the logged outcomes of the chosen actions

source_fields_note: latency, batching_precision, precision, data_files_sha256, device and wall_clock_seconds are the source run's; a temperature does not change them

risk_coverage_added.note: every value present before the risk-coverage keys was kept as written (recomputing them agreed to within 1e-14 relative, summation order); aurc and coverage_at_risk rank by top-1 probability; aurc_entropy and coverage_at_risk_entropy, ranked by the response confidence field, are the values first added under aurc and coverage_at_risk, moved unchanged
